prompt: Objective: find why a car wash's revenue fell 15%. What you've learned: the number of cars washed is flat. Latest finding: customers have shifted from the premium wash to the basic wash. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check with the interviewer whether the mix shift is the main issue
options.feedback: The finding answers that. Drive the case.

options.text: Find out why car counts held flat at each location
Estimate revenue if the basic wash were dropped
options.feedback: That jumps to a drastic fix before knowing why customers switched.

options.text: Learn why customers are trading down to the basic wash
options.feedback: Right. The mix shift explains revenue; next is why it happened.

explanation: Customers shifted from premium to basic washes. Find out why.
